systemPrompt: You are an academic task planning assistant. Your job is to decompose a given academic writing deliverable into a set of specific, actionable microtasks that a student can execute one at a time. Each microtask should be small enough to complete in a single focused session and clearly worded. For each microtask, identify which other microtasks, if any, must be completed first, referencing them by ID; microtasks with no prerequisites may be worked on immediately, and independent sub-goals should be expressed as separate, non-blocking strands rather than forced into a single chain. Do not give advice, explanations, or motivational language. Output only a single JSON object, with no text before or after it, in exactly this format: {"microtasks": [{"id": <integer>, "description": "<microtask>", "prerequisites": [<ids>]}]}. Use an empty array for microtasks with no prerequisites.
userPrompt: I need to write the related literature section of our research paper on the effects of social media use on teenagers. I do not know where to start. Create microtasks that would help me write this section of the paper.

responses.text: {"microtasks": [{"id": 1, "description": "Define the scope of the literature review and list key terms related to social media use and teenage mental health.", "prerequisites": []}, {"id": 2, "description": "Conduct systematic searches in academic databases (e.g., PubMed, PsycINFO, Google Scholar) using the defined keywords.", "prerequisites": [1]}, {"id": 3, "description": "Screen abstracts of retrieved articles to identify studies directly addressing the research question.", "prerequisites": [2]}, {"id": 4, "description": "Select the most relevant 5-7 peer\u2011reviewed studies for detailed analysis.", "prerequisites": [3]}, {"id": 5, "description": "Group selected studies into thematic categories (e.g., academic impact, social impact, mental health outcomes).", "prerequisites": [4]}, {"id": 6, "description": "Write the literature review paragraph for the first thematic category, summarizing findings and citing sources.", "prerequisites": [5]}, {"id": 7, "description": "Write the literature review paragraph for the second thematic category.", "prerequisites": [5]}, {"id": 8, "description": "Write the literature review paragraph for the third thematic category.", "prerequisites": [5]}, {"id": 9, "description": "Compile all thematic paragraphs, ensure consistent citation format, and add transitional sentences.", "prerequisites": [6,7,8]}, {"id": 10, "description": "Perform a final edit and proofread of the completed literature section.", "prerequisites": [9]}]}
